name: Papercut
source:
A love-affair drama about a housewife, who struggles to have children with her husband. After a few years, their marriage starts to die out, and she's looking for something new in her life. Perhaps that new young paperboy could be it. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20052]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一部关于家庭主妇努力与丈夫生孩子的爱情剧。几年后，他们的婚姻开始走向终结，她正在寻找生活中的新东西。也许那个新来的年轻报童就是这样的人。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20052]引理软论坛[/url]]
